summary: APi Group Corp (NYSE: APG) filed an 8-K announcing a $500M senior unsecured notes offering by its wholly owned subsidiary APi Group DE, Inc. to fund acquisitions of Onyx-Fire Protection Services and Wtech Fire Group, plus an amendment to its existing credit agreement to extend Term Loan B maturity to 2033 and upsize the revolver to $1.0B maturing 2031. The notes are offered under Rule 144A/Regulation S. No specific terms, pricing, or advisor named in excerpt. What to watch: market reception of the notes offering and timing of the acquisitions.
